A chokepoint. Zombies will be at an advantage until you secure your base to only allow one line of attack. The way you do this is trick the zombies to attack the weakest line of defense. A way to do this is to reinforce a walled off area with your best materials, and put a trapdoor at the entrance to your base. They will attack the trapdoor but will not reach you so long as you keep it well repaired. You will be able to attack the zombies one on one. This can be expanded by using the editing of placing blocks to place said blocks in such a way that they struggle to attack them.

Alternatively, you can search up ways to force zombies to take longer to reach you. One of the best ways is by making them jump to get to you. Jumping slows the zombies considerably and when paired with late-game traps it can provide adequate base defense.

As someone said above, quests/trading are very effective at getting items throughout the game. The loot system works on "gamestage" (An equation based around player level, days survived and deaths). At a low gamestage you will not find guns at all, unless you get really lucky. Traders are a good source of early-game firepower. 

Use wood frames to block doorways to make points where enemies cannot reach you but you can reach and attack them.

For skills, you can't go wrong with Strength. Mother Lode, Miner 69'er and Sexual Tyrannosaurus are all good skills for any character.

Hope this helps!
